source:
@@U04473@@
You heard the Master! Get to work! Tomorrow there’s a seamen’s festival!

@@U04475@@
The old man welcomed us like animals. A he-man’s fest might set it right.

@@U04477@@
(To the audience.)

@@U04478@@
So here we have it once again; it was Naboth’s vineyard then.

@@U04481@@
(On the watchtower, singing.)

@@U04482@@
Begotten to see, To watch day and night, Sworn to my tower, The world’s my delight. I scan the far distance, I note what is near, The moon and the stars, The forests, the deer. Thus beauty eternal I see all around, I’m glad to be praising The joy I have found. O fortunate eyes, Whatever you've seen, Whatever its outcome, How lovely it’s been.

@@U04483@@
(Pause. Speaks.)

@@U04484@@
It's not alone for enjoyment I’m posted here.
translation:
@@U04473@@
你听到了师父的话！开始工作吧！明天就是海员节啦！

@@U04475@@
老人像动物一样欢迎我们。男人的盛宴可能会纠正这一点。

@@U04477@@
（对观众。）

@@U04478@@
所以我们又看到了；那时那是纳博斯的葡萄园。

@@U04481@@
（在瞭望塔上，歌唱。）

@@U04482@@
生来观看，昼夜观看，誓守我的塔，世界是我的快乐。我扫视远处，注意近处，月亮和星星，森林，鹿。因此，我看到周围都是永恒的美丽，我很高兴赞美我找到的快乐。哦，幸运的眼睛，无论你看到了什么，无论结果如何，它都是多么可爱。

@@U04483@@
（停顿。说话。）

@@U04484@@
我发在这里并不是为了享受。
